snippet.title: Pit Panic – Official Gameplay Trailer | Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
Escape the sinking Aztec temple in Pit Panic — a fast-paced rogue-like platformer where every second counts.

Dig your own path upward, jump and climb through collapsing ruins, collect treasure, unlock powerful upgrades, and survive chaotic encounters deep beneath the surface.

💎 Fast arcade-style platforming
💀 Rogue-like runs with unique upgrades
🏆 Daily leaderboards
🐍 Dangerous traps, enemies, and bosses
⛏️ Dig your own escape route

🎮 Coming to: Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2

Demo of Pit Panic is out NOW on Steam - try it and let us know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491490/Pit_Panic/
